title: kate-ui: rank the quick open rows
summary: palette.rs turns a file list and a query into PaletteRow values with the file name as label, the relative path as detail, and the matched positions, best first. step_selection moves the highlighted row with wrap around. The palette window paints these rows.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. The file has no GPUI import, but kate-ui tests run in the rust (macos-15) job and the Mac lane owns crates/kate-ui.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Create palette.rs with the SPDX header and add mod palette; to lib.rs with the dead_code attribute. quick_open_rows scores each path with kate_core::fuzzy_match_path, sorts by score highest first and stable, truncates to limit, and builds a row per hit with label equal to the text after the last slash. An empty query lists the first limit paths in order. The test quick_open_rows_rank_the_file_name uses [src/main.rs, docs/main.md, README.md] with query main and asserts two rows whose first label is main.rs or main.md by score and whose details are the paths, and that step_selection(2, 3, 1) is 0 and step_selection(0, 3, -1) is 2. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: palette::tests::quick_open_rows_rank_the_file_name
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because palette.rs does not exist. After the change the matching paths are rows with labels and positions and the selection wraps.
